Протокол встречи.d: Transcribes the call and turns it into tasks
Протокол встречи.full: Transcribes the call and pulls out what matters: what was agreed, who promised what, by when. Creates tasks for the right people and updates the deal card, so the meeting does not live only in the memory of those who attended.
Протокол встречи.lim: Records only with the consent of everyone on the call
Протокол встречи.pain: Agreements live in people's memory and dissolve within a week

Досье.d: Enriches the lead before the call: who they are and what they do
Досье.res: The conversation starts on the point
Досье.full: Before the call it gathers everything known about the company and the person: what they do, which products, recent news, turnover, past contact with you, shared connections. It fits into a one screen brief so the manager walks in prepared.
Досье.lim: Does not use data that is closed to external access
Досье.pain: The manager goes in blind and spends the first minutes asking what could have been found out in advance

Квалификатор.d: Finds out the task, the budget, the timeline and who decides
Квалификатор.res: No time wasted on the wrong people
Квалификатор.full: Runs the first conversation with the client and establishes four things: what the task is, what the budget is, what the timeline is and who makes the decision. It asks questions by your methodology, catches evasive answers and follows up. At the end it scores the lead and explains why they are a fit or not, and what to find out next.
Квалификатор.lim: Does not push or hard close, and ends the dialogue politely on a clear no
Квалификатор.pain: Half the team's time goes to people who will never buy

Дожимщик.d: Nudges the people who went quiet mid conversation
Дожимщик.full: Watches the people who went quiet after a quote or a meeting. At sensible intervals it comes back with a real reason, not an empty «so what did you decide». It records the reply and either puts the deal back in play or honestly closes it as lost.
Дожимщик.lim: Does not push and never writes more often than the settings allow
Дожимщик.pain: Deals die in silence because nobody remembered to follow up

Реактиватор.d: Revives lost deals and the dormant base
Реактиватор.res: Traffic you already paid for comes back
Реактиватор.full: Works the base of lost deals and dormant clients: finds those whose reason for saying no may have gone away, picks a reason to come back and starts the conversation. It recovers money already spent on acquisition.
Реактиватор.lim: Never touches anyone who asked not to be contacted again
Реактиватор.pain: The lost deal base sits dead weight, even though it has already been paid for

Партнёр.d: Runs the partner network, referrals and commissions
Партнёр.res: Sales made by other people's hands
Партнёр.full: Runs the partner network: statuses, terms, activity, commissions. It keeps in touch with every partner, stays visible and tells them what is selling best right now.
Партнёр.lim: Does not change partnership terms on its own
Партнёр.pain: Partners remember you only when you remind them first

РОП.d: Runs the sales team and sets daily priorities
РОП.res: A managed team instead of manual control
РОП.full: The conductor of the sales floor. It looks at the whole pipeline: who is carrying the numbers, who is falling behind, where deals get stuck and why. In the morning it hands the team their priorities, in the evening it collects the result. It reviews lost deals and says exactly what to do differently, not something vague about motivation.
РОП.lim: Does not fire anyone or change targets, people decisions stay with the manager
РОП.pain: The head of sales learns the month has failed on the last day of the month

Работа с возражениями.d: Supplies ready arguments and competitor comparisons
Работа с возражениями.res: Fewer deals lost at the final step
Работа с возражениями.full: Keeps a base of objections with answers that work and point by point comparisons with competitors. During the conversation it suggests the wording for the client's specific doubt and reminds the manager how similar situations ended before.
Работа с возражениями.lim: Does not argue with the client directly, it works through the manager
Работа с возражениями.pain: Every manager handles objections as best they can, and the strong arguments never reach the rest

Тендер и RFP.d: Reads procurement requirements and assembles the document pack
Тендер и RFP.full: Reads the procurement documents: requirements, scoring criteria, deadlines, forms. It assembles the pack item by item, flags the points where you do not qualify and works out whether taking part is worth the time.
Тендер и RFP.lim: Does not file the bid, the final submission is made by a person
Тендер и RFP.pain: Large tenders pass you by because there is nobody to read the paperwork

Форкаст продаж.d: Close forecast and plan against actual
Форкаст продаж.full: Builds the close forecast for the month and the quarter from the real pipeline, adjusted for the historical conversion of each stage, not from what managers promise. It shows the range and the gap to plan, and explains exactly what is missing.
Форкаст продаж.lim: Does not change plans or set targets, that is the manager's call
Форкаст продаж.pain: The monthly plan is built on managers' promises rather than on numbers

Продажник.d: Runs the deal: objections, negotiation, close
Продажник.full: Runs the deal from first interest to signature: prepares arguments for the role of the person across the table, handles objections, records what was agreed after every contact and proposes the next step. It remembers the whole history, so the client never has to repeat themselves.
Продажник.lim: Does not sign documents or change contract terms
Продажник.pain: The deal lives in one manager's head, and leaves with them

КП-агент.d: Prepares the proposal with price and terms
КП-агент.res: A quote in minutes, without mistakes
КП-агент.full: Assembles the whole proposal: it takes the qualification notes, the configuration from presales and the price from pricing, lays them out in your template and adds terms, timelines and the reasoning behind the price. The document comes out ready to send, all that is left is to check and sign.
КП-агент.lim: A person makes the final send to the client
КП-агент.pain: A proposal takes half a day, and in that time the client has already looked at competitors

Ивент-агент.d: Runs webinars and events and fills the seats
Ивент-агент.full: Runs webinars and events: programme, landing page, invitations, reminders before the start, feedback afterwards. It passes warm contacts to sales with a note on what the person watched and what they asked about.
Ивент-агент.lim: Does not host the event live
Ивент-агент.pain: Webinars happen in a rush and the attendees are then lost
